entities.name: Satsuki
entities.description: Human Druid of Kamigawa and member of the Living Historians who records history as tattoos brought to life in performance.

entities.name: Living Historians
entities.description: Group that preserves the past by recording events faithfully and tattooing them on their skin.

entities.name: Kodama
entities.description: Tree spirits whom Satsuki says keep history better than any digital device.

events.summary: Satsuki and the Living Historians record history, tattooing stories on their skin and bringing them to life through dance, theater and song.

relations.quote: Satsuki is a member of the Living Historians
